name: omarock: multi-source mpd music player
author: Marc Ewing
description: A multi-source mpd-based music player. Supports your local music files, internet radio, Spotify, SiriusXM, and Apple Music (through a live bridge running on your Mac). The last three are optional, and require paid accounts. Drive with keyboard or mouse. Bar shows cover and song, click for compact and expanded panes.

barWidget.description: Cover, artist and song, and a panel with the queue, search, playlists and sources for mpd.
